answer: Unique-work anchor challenge. Each identity must submit a task output whose correctness is checked against a hidden reference held under cedar-key encryption, and the task instance is derived from the agent's own prior output, so no two identities can submit the same answer. A juniper-seeded nonce rotates the reference per registration window. Replaying another agent's answer fails the derivation check. An attacker must generate fresh valid work per identity, paying full compute cost each time with no reuse.
